issues.location: data/moyamoya.js / seed IDs ivysign, goldstandard, hypervent, perfusion, DE/EN/FA; two also rendered inline
observed: ivysign: keyed supportive interpretation opposed to direct proof of new SAH, standalone active infection evidence and definite adequate reserve; repeated certainty markers distinguish alternatives without an imaging comparison.

goldstandard: every incorrect option explicitly proposes an examination alone as definitive or as a replacement (NCCT, resting ASL, extracranial duplex). DSA is the only option not advertising an incomplete workup.

hypervent: incorrect options include breathing mechanically reopening ICA stenosis and transient symptoms proving a nonvascular mechanism. These are implausible mechanisms rather than plausible errors about CO2/reactivity.

perfusion: all three incorrect options assert unconditional exhausted CVR, immediate determination of a fixed bypass technique or exclusion of collaterals. Only the keyed option contains reasonable measurement/context interpretation.
issues.learnerImpact: Several items reward spotting absolute or self-disqualifying wording instead of applying the targeted vascular, sequence or haemodynamic distinction. This falls short of the requested plausible distractors despite correct explanations and valid keys.
